title: Optimizer Update Available
release_notes:
• Pure Root Power Engine: Fully unlocked for rooted devices (su / UID 0)
• Removed Shizuku bridge and background real-time service in favor of direct root execution
• Kernel Memory Compaction & PageCache Flushing (drop_caches & vm tuning)
• Low Memory Killer (LMK) Immunity: locks oom_score_adj to -1000 for protected apps
• SurfaceFlinger zero-latency rendering and Qualcomm GPU devfreq boost
• Kernel TCP BBR stack tuning & iptables QoS/DSCP packet prioritization
